Inbound SMB devtools startup building a code assistant + repo search. Mostly self-serve but moving to AE/SE touch. Short notes / fragments below:
- Source: organic search -> pricing page -> contact form. Signed up and ran quick tests with free credits.
- Primary workload: code-assistant (long-context), repo-search, inline summarization of PRs. Expect long documents (20k-100k tokens) per request in some flows.
- Pain points: current provider rate limits too low for high-concurrency dev environment. Need burst capacity for CI/codegen jobs.
- SDK ask: robust JS/TS SDK examples for streaming tokens, reconnect/resume, chunked uploads, and auto-chunking long contexts. Also asked for Python examples for backend batching.
- Performance targets: ~200ms per token not required; main ask is predictable tail latency for interactive UX (95th < 1s per token ideally). Throughput: 30-100 concurrent users during peak office hours.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; wants guidance on batching/caching to reduce unit cost. Interested in Optimize recommendations.
- Security: SOC2 expected within procurement window; immediate ask for SSO/SAML optional but not blocking. Audit logs and retention controls required. Data residency: prefer us-west region.
- Quote from founder: "We want self-serve onboarding to be frictionless, but need clear SDK guidance and predictable rate limits for the team to build on top."
- POC ask: 2-week trial with raised quota, sample SDK, and one integration call.
- Technical notes: prefers public cloud, no VPC/on-prem for now. Will revisit Dedicated if ARR > $30k/mo.
- Next steps: send pricing + quota steps, attach SDK snippet, schedule 30m integration call.
